summary: The conclusions follow from the stated common canonical instance and the supplied predecessor facts. The parent flux is a coordinatewise subcapacity of q; positivity of the parent and child loads gives the common missed-edge formula for b and the reservoir product comparison; complementary saturation makes the parent KKT slack affinely realizable, yielding both bounds in (21); the ledger and the pointwise flux inequality yield (22)-(23); and the amplified centroid measure is a nonzero submeasure of the canonical reservoir-centroid measure, so the two depth-capacity copies give (25) and the stated residual-rank screen (26). All strict inequalities, constants, support-disjointness claims, and branch qualifications are consistent.
